provider: Illustrative mapping prepared by the gateway operator, Andrei Besleaga, from the reporting subject's own published Annual Report and Accounts 2024 to 2025, Annex 3 (sustainability data tables); NOT published, reviewed, authorized, or endorsed by the reporting subject. Every figure is read from the source document named in methodology-uri. Scope caveats: The figures are for HMRC's FINANCIAL year 2024-25 (1 April 2024 - 31 March 2025), NOT the 2025 calendar year; reporting-period carries the year in which it ended and reporting-period-basis, under the extension name urn:uuid:58f04ecf-c558-4674-8dc6-c8bdbb6a8041, states the boundary. The source tables print thousands (tCO2e 000s, kWh 000s): carbon-footprint is the 'Total gross emissions' row, 33.16 thousand tCO2e. energy-consumption is the SUM of the five energy rows the table fills for 2024-25 (electricity non-renewable 2,323, electricity renewable 54,969, gas 57,432, oil 300, Stratford district heating 5,136, all thousand kWh); the table prints no total. The source gives Scope 1 and 2 only combined (25.41 thousand) and Scope 3 for business travel only (7.75 thousand), so no scope member is carried; no accounting basis is stated, so carbon-accounting is omitted.
